stories.title: Anthony Bowens expected to remain with AEW
stories.tldr: Anthony Bowens is expected to remain with All Elite Wrestling after his contract expired in early October alongside former tag team partner Max Caster. While Caster departed the company and wrestled for TNA, backstage sources indicate that Bowens has either re-signed or will finalize a new deal soon. Bowens remained on the official AEW roster page throughout the process, unlike Caster. Fans should not expect a reunion with The Acclaimed, as Bowens recently shut down that possibility on social media.

stories.title: The Young Bucks and Nick Jackson on their original vision for AEW as 'PWG on illegal steroids'
stories.tldr: During a recent Q&A session ahead of AEW Full Gear, Executive Vice Presidents The Young Bucks reflected on the origins of All Elite Wrestling. Nick Jackson revealed that their original vision for the company was essentially Pro Wrestling Guerrilla on illegal steroids, bringing high-energy, indie-style matches to a major global stage. Matt and Nick also reminisced about their history with the now-hiatus indie promotion and Nick's initial, humorous skepticism toward Tony Khan's pitches when the company was first being conceived.

stories.title: Video game 'Foxhole' features tribute to late AEW star PAC
stories.tldr: The popular multiplayer war video game Foxhole is honoring the late AEW star PAC with a unique tribute in its upcoming Engines of War update. The game is introducing an anti-tank weapon called the P-A-C Bastard Burst Launcher, which nods to the wrestler's famous nickname and initials. PAC tragically passed away on September 27 at the age of 40 due to bronchial asthma, prompting an ongoing wave of tributes from fans, colleagues, and his wife, Natalie.

stories.title: Matches set for the November 18 episode of AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Tony Khan has announced a stacked lineup for the November 18 episode of AEW Dynamite from Denver, Colorado, featuring the explosive kick-off of the 2026 Continental Classic tournament. The opening round will see recent allies turn opponents as Hangman Adam Page battles Bandido, alongside Gold League bouts matching Jon Moxley against Orange Cassidy and Speedball Mike Bailey against Nick Wayne. Additionally, Queen Aminata will defend her TBS Championship in a high-stakes four-way match against AZM, Maya World, and Mina Shirakawa.

stories.title: Sheamus fuels AEW rumors after posting photos with Kazuchika Okada
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Sheamus has intensified speculation about a potential move to AEW after sharing photos with AEW star Kazuchika Okada at a red carpet movie premiere. Sheamus has been a free agent since his 19-year WWE contract expired in October, leaving fans guessing about his next career move. Although he has previously sidestepped direct questions about signing with Tony Khan's promotion, this latest social media activity has renewed fan demands for a dream match between the two veterans.

stories.title: AEW and Mercedes Moné partner with USA Wrestling women's freestyle team
stories.tldr: AEW, Mercedes Mone, and media entrepreneur Keven Undergaro have launched a landmark partnership with USA Wrestling to elevate the U.S. women's freestyle wrestling team ahead of the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles. Mone has been appointed Chief Executive Envoy to mentor and raise awareness for the athletes, utilizing her global platform to spearhead what she calls the Women's Amateur Wrestling Evolution. Meanwhile, AEW steps in as the team's Official Content Partner, offering cross-platform exposure and opportunities for wrestlers to connect with fans and talent at weekly events. The collaboration aims to bridge amateur and professional wrestling, bringing mainstream visibility and brand-building support to world-class female competitors.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett missed AEW Full Gear due to travel disruptions
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Jeff Jarrett recently explained why he was forced to miss the AEW Full Gear pay-per-view event. Severe FAA-related travel disruptions impacted travel across the United States, affecting multiple wrestling promotions including AEW, WWE, and TNA Destination X. Jarrett encountered severe delays during his Minneapolis connection due to a missing first officer, ultimately missing his window to reach the event in Edmonton, Canada. He decided to fly back home to Nashville, though his checked luggage accidentally ended up in Phoenix instead.

stories.title: Tony Khan addresses whether AEW Blood & Guts could become a PPV
stories.tldr: Tony Khan recently addressed whether the AEW Blood and Guts match could ever transition from a television special into its own standalone pay-per-view event. Following the strong ratings success of Blood and Guts 2026 on TBS, Khan made it clear that he prefers keeping the marquee match as a signature TV special to drive viewership. He emphasized that having high-profile, pay-per-view quality episodes of Dynamite and Collision is vital for giving fans exciting events to look forward to on regular television.

stories.title: Cole Karter's status with AEW following reports of his release
stories.tldr: Despite widespread backstage rumors and claims from Cole Karter himself that he was fired, an AEW source clarifies that his departure is not yet finalized. Management has not made a definitive choice regarding his employment following his disputed absence from television tapings. Meanwhile, updates have also emerged regarding Anthony Bowens, who is expected to stay with the promotion as contract talks continue.

stories.title: Backstage update on MJF fan-kicking incident at AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: MJF accidentally kicked a fan in the face while fleeing the crowd after attacking Will Ospreay at AEW Full Gear, prompting a comedic kayfabe blame campaign from his legal team. Despite the heel antics online, backstage reports indicate the fan was tended to immediately by staff. While she was initially unhappy about the mishap, she was not seriously hurt and the situation is expected to be fully resolved.

stories.title: Adam Copeland's bear encounter before AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: AEW star Adam Copeland had a frightening real-life encounter with a mother bear and her cubs while walking his dogs in a residential neighborhood just days before Full Gear. Unable to raise his arms to appear larger because he was holding his dogs leashes, Copeland made a split-second decision to kick the approaching animal underneath the jaw with his shin. The strike caused the bear to retreat, allowing Copeland and his dogs to escape safely, though the impact left him with a painful injury that he carried into his opening match against Kazuchika Okada.

stories.title: AEW fires Cole Karter over ROH absence
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has reportedly fired Cole Karter following an investigation into a disputed absence from Ring of Honor television tapings. According to backstage reports, management discovered that Karter had been dishonest about a family-related excuse used to miss the events, prompting his sudden release weeks ago. This marks the second time the 26-year-old wrestler has been let down by a major promotion, following his 2022 departure from WWE NXT where he competed as Troy Donovan.

stories.title: Jimmy Korderas criticizes AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: Former WWE referee Jimmy Korderas slammed AEW Full Gear in a scathing social media video, calling the event a complete disappointment and describing everything outside of a few good matches as complete slop. Korderas specifically criticized the heavy reliance on weapons, chaotic match formats, and excessive blood, pointing out that half the pay-per-view matches featured bleeding. He singled out the lengthy Texas Death Match and Anarchy in the Arena as prime examples of the promotion prioritizing over-the-top spectacle over effective professional wrestling.

stories.title: AEW announces three-week Collision residency in January 2027
stories.tldr: AEW has announced a three-week Collision residency taking place in January 2027 at the Arlington Expo Center in Arlington, Texas. The Saturday night shows will run on January 9, January 16, and January 23, following previous successful residencies at the venue that Tony Khan praised for its unique chemistry and atmosphere. Alongside this announcement, AEW revealed a slate of Wednesday Night Dynamite dates for January and early February leading up to AEW Dynasty 2027 in Liverpool, England. Tickets for the Arlington residency go on sale to the general public on Monday, November 23.

stories.title: PAC's wife pens emotional note
stories.tldr: Nearly two months after the tragic passing of AEW wrestler PAC at the age of 40, his wife Natalie Satterley has shared an emotional tribute on Instagram. Satterley opened up about the immense difficulty of facing the upcoming Christmas season without him, noting how much he adored the holidays and how everyday reminders leave her heartbroken. She also expressed deep gratitude for the overwhelming support from family, friends, colleagues, and fans during this difficult time.

stories.title: Tony Khan discusses potential future AEW tournaments
stories.tldr: Following AEW Full Gear, Tony Khan discussed the upcoming Continental Classic during the post-show press conference and hinted at the possibility of introducing new tournaments in the future. He acknowledged fan demand for women's and tag team variations, noting that successful elements of the C2 could inspire future formats. Khan heavily praised the current tournament's strict rules, including its zero-tolerance policy for outside interference and unique three-point scoring system. While he left the door open for future concepts utilizing these rules, he did not officially announce any new tournaments.

stories.title: Anthony Bowens on planned Billy & Chuck reunion in AEW
stories.tldr: Anthony Bowens recently revealed that a planned Billy and Chuck reunion was supposed to take place during the Daddy Ass Birthday Bash on AEW Dynamite in November 2022. Bowens originally wrote a segment where Chuck Palumbo would return to reunite with Billy Gunn before turning on him during an attack alongside Swerve Strickland and Keith Lee. Unfortunately, Palumbo ultimately did not appear, and backup plans involving Sean X-Pac Waltman also fell through. Today, Bowens is enjoying free time following the expiration of his AEW contract while exploring potential modeling and acting opportunities.

stories.title: Juice Robinson expected to take time off from AEW
stories.tldr: Juice Robinson is reportedly expected to take time off from All Elite Wrestling following an angle on Collision where he was written off television. His upcoming absence aligns with the anticipated return of his wife, former AEW Women's Champion Toni Storm, who has been sidelined since March following a backstage attack. Although Storm is not injured, her return has been heavily teased through mysterious cassette tapes distributed to media members and shared on social media. While an immediate in-ring return may not be imminent, reports indicate she could soon be factored into programming in other capacities.

stories.title: Mike Bailey message ahead of AEW Continental Classic
stories.tldr: Mike Bailey is more determined than ever to win singles gold in AEW despite his recent unsuccessful challenge against Tommaso Ciampa for the AEW National Championship on Dynamite. Reflecting on a busy week that included AEW Full Gear 2026, the high-flying star expressed confidence in his trajectory and motivation. He is now turning his full attention toward the upcoming AEW Continental Classic tournament, which kicks off next week in Denver, Colorado.

stories.title: Veteran wrestler criticizes blood drinking spot at AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: During the 2026 AEW Full Gear pay-per-view event, a Texas Death Match between Swerve Strickland and New Level versus Adam Page and Brodido featured a controversial spot where Swerve drank Page's blood. Hall of Fame veteran wrestler Ricky Morton publicly criticized the moment on social media, arguing that it crossed the line from pushing boundaries into cheap shock value that ultimately turns viewers away. Despite Morton and some fans taking issue with the visceral display, the match itself was overwhelmingly praised by the broader wrestling community, earning a high rating of 9.33 out of 10 on the CAGEMATCH database.

stories.title: Sarah Stock claims Megha Parekh prevented her from working in AEW
stories.tldr: Former AEW producer and coach Sarah Stock has revealed that she was kept from working for the promotion for three months after being hired and placed on the payroll. Stock alleged that former legal department employee Megha Parekh repeatedly made excuses and failed to inform Tony Khan that her paperwork was ready. Stock eventually bypassed legal and HR by contacting a former WWE colleague in the AEW office, who helped her finally secure a start date.

stories.title: AEW Continental Classic 2026 participants announced
stories.tldr: The twelve competitors for the tournament have been officially divided into the Blue and Gold leagues following the selection special. Defending champion Jon Moxley headlines the Gold League alongside Kevin Knight, Orange Cassidy, Nick Wayne, Mike Bailey, and Tommaso Ciampa. The Blue League features an equally stacked lineup of Jay White, Hangman Adam Page, Ricochet, Daniel Garcia, Brody King, and Bandido. The round-robin action will operate under strict tournament rules before culminating at Worlds End on December 19.

stories.title: Former WWE NXT star fired from AEW
stories.tldr: Former WWE NXT and AEW wrestler Cole Karter has reportedly been fired by Tony Khan in a rare outright release by the company. Sources indicate Karter was let go after management discovered he fabricated a family emergency to miss a set of Ring of Honor tapings in Jacksonville. This marks the second time in recent years that Karter has been terminated by a major wrestling promotion, following his 2022 WWE release.

stories.title: AEW releases video teasing return of Toni Storm
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has released a mysterious social media teaser featuring a package marked with Play Me and a lipstick kiss, heavily signaling the eventual return of former champion Timeless Toni Storm. This digital promo follows similar cassette tapes planted for media members at last month's WrestleDream pay-per-view and comes on the heels of comments made by Tony Khan at the Full Gear post-show press conference. Storm has been out of action since March 2026 following a match at Revolution and a subsequent backstage attack by an unknown assailant, and while an official return date has not been announced, her looming comeback is generating significant excitement.

stories.title: Deonna Purrazzo criticizes lack of character development in AEW women's division
stories.tldr: AEW star Deonna Purrazzo recently criticized the lack of character development and storytelling opportunities in the women's division. During a recent interview, she explained that without promotional vignettes or backstage segments, fans cannot emotionally invest in the wrestlers or understand their motivations. Purrazzo used her own television absence and undeveloped Virtuosa persona to illustrate how a lack of foundational character work hinders audience connection. She believes that establishing distinct, relatable, or detestable characters is the vital key to earning better storylines, increased television time, and prominent main event matches.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez compares Kyle Fletcher's Full Gear performance to Steve Austin
stories.tldr: Wrestling journalist Bryan Alvarez recently compared Kyle Fletcher's standout performance against Will Ospreay at AEW Full Gear to Steve Austin's iconic WrestleMania 13 match against Bret Hart. Alvarez noted that the bout was expertly designed to elevate Fletcher into a big-time babyface and argued that the young star should be positioned as a future world champion sooner rather than later. Despite coming up short in the main event, Fletcher's star-making performance was overshadowed only by a post-match return and attack from MJF.

stories.title: The Motor City Machine Guns drive 750 miles to reach AEW Full Gear amid flight ground stop
stories.tldr: During a nationwide flight ground stop in the United States, The Motor City Machine Guns consisting of Chris Sabin and Alex Shelley faced severe travel disruptions. After wrestling at West Coast Pro Wrestling for the promotion's eighth anniversary show following a four and a half hour tarmac delay, their connecting flights for the next morning were abruptly canceled. Refusing to miss their scheduled appearance, Sabin and Shelley rented a car and drove 750 miles from San Francisco to Phoenix to successfully make the AEW Full Gear pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Max Caster discusses expecting heat on break from pro wrestling
stories.tldr: Former professional wrestling star Max Caster is currently taking an extended break from the industry following intense backlash over a controversial rap referencing a deadly missile strike in Saudi Arabia at TNA Bound for Glory. During a recent live online signing, Caster addressed his history of controversy, including a past AEW rap involving Jeff and Karen Jarrett, admitting that he has simply come to accept the constant heat he receives for his lyrics. Following the Bound for Glory incident, TNA completely severed ties with the wrestler and scrubbed him from their platforms, prompting Caster to issue a public apology and announce his hiatus.

stories.title: Steven Borden explains why he doesn't wear Sting's face paint in AEW
stories.tldr: Steven Borden, son of wrestling legend Sting, has explained why he chooses not to wear his father's iconic face paint or use his signature mannerisms in AEW. Teaming up with Darby Allin, Borden wants to carve out his own unique legacy rather than simply playing the greatest hits of his father's career. Despite early physical comparisons from veterans like Jim Ross and a recent minor concussion setback, the rookie is focused on building his own path in the wrestling industry without running from pressure.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo discusses Ric Flair's last match
stories.tldr: During a recent appearance on Talk Is Jericho, AEW star Andrade El Idolo revealed that he was unaware Ric Flair suffered a heart attack during their 2022 tag team match. Andrade admitted he was terrified beforehand about something happening to the wrestling legend, but he ultimately thought Flair was simply selling when he stayed down in the ring. He only learned months later after a doctor's visit that Flair had actually suffered a heart attack during the bout, though The Nature Boy was remarkably drinking backstage later that same night.

stories.title: Chris Jericho discusses playing Gorgeous George in Amazon Prime series
stories.tldr: AEW star Chris Jericho recently discussed landing the role of legendary professional wrestling pioneer Gorgeous George in an upcoming Amazon Prime limited series about Muhammad Ali titled The Greatest. Jericho explained that the production team struggled to find the right actor until he auditioned and captured Wagner's authentic cadence and personality. The series explores how Gorgeous George heavily inspired Muhammad Ali, then known as Cassius Clay, to develop his iconic, trash-talking persona following a meeting in Las Vegas.

stories.title: MJF's 'legal counsel' issues statement after fan accidentally kicked at AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: Following his accidental kick to a fan during his return at AEW Full Gear, MJF and his on-screen lawyer Mark Sterling have comically turned the blame onto the victim. Sterling issued a fake legal statement claiming MJF is graciously choosing not to sue the woman for obstructing his path. Backstage updates confirmed the fan was uninjured and in good spirits, while MJF prepares to address his return on the upcoming episode of Dynamite.

stories.title: WWE skeptical of Tony Khan's claims regarding long-term AEW contract for Persephone
stories.tldr: Following Tony Khan's announcement that Persephone is secured to a long-term contract, WWE officials have reportedly expressed skepticism regarding the true length of the deal. Sources indicate that WWE had already suspected she would remain with AEW and CMLL long-term due to her frequent bookings over the summer. Meanwhile, WWE continues its active pursuit of adding bilingual female talent to its rosters across WWE, NXT, and AAA.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer & Bryan Alvarez review AEW Full Gear 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Full Gear 2026 featured major moments like MJF returning to attack the world champion and a heavily criticized women's tag team match. Dave Meltzer and Bryan Alvarez recently shared their overall positive reviews of the event on Wrestling Observer Radio. Meltzer enjoyed nearly every match aside from the Texas Death bout, while Alvarez felt certain matches ran too long and featured anticlimactic finishes. The event also saw The Cut win Anarchy in the Arena and Swerve Strickland capture the Trios Championships.

stories.title: Creed Brothers debut in AEW at Full Gear 2026
stories.tldr: Following their surprise debut at Full Gear 2026, Tony Khan officially confirmed that Jacob and Drew Kasper have signed with AEW. During the pay-per-view, the brothers also came face-to-face with FTR and Stokely Hathaway, hinting at past NXT ties. Khan officially welcomed the duo to the roster as they immediately insert themselves into the tag team championship picture.

stories.title: The Kasper Brothers (FKA The Creeds) Make Surprise AEW Debut at Full Gear
stories.tldr: Just one week after their WWE departures, former Creed Brothers Julius and Brutus debuted at AEW Full Gear 2026 under their real names as Jacob and Drew Kasper. The duo shocked fans by launching a vicious attack on AEW World Tag Team Champions The Young Bucks and number one contenders the Motor City Machine Guns. They then aligned themselves with FTR and their former NXT manager Stokely Hathaway. AEW President Tony Khan officially confirmed their signing shortly after the event.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland & New Level Win AEW Trios Titles in Texas Death Match at Full Gear
stories.tldr: At AEW Full Gear 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona, Swerve Strickland and The New Level defeated Hangman Adam Page and Brodido in a brutal and bloody Texas Death Match to recapture the AEW World Trios Championships. The chaotic contest featured an extreme assortment of weapons, including barbed wire tables, thumbtacks, staple guns, glass panes, and an explosive Power Glove. The finish saw Strickland counter a Buckshot Lariat with a steel chair before laying out Page with a House Call to secure the triple knockout victory, adding another violent chapter to their championship rivalry.

stories.title: Kris Statlander and Harley Cameron Win AEW Women's Tag Team Championship at Full Gear
stories.tldr: At AEW Full Gear on November 14, 2026, Kris Statlander and Harley Cameron, known as Wrathlander, defeated Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor to capture the AEW Women's World Tag Team Championships. After a comedic pre-match segment featuring Billy Gunn and Tony Khan, the challengers overcame the champions in a hard-fought battle. The decisive moment occurred when Cameron pulled Hayter out of the ring to disrupt their finishing sequence, allowing Statlander to hit Saturday Night Fever on Windsor for the pinfall. The victory brought historic milestones, making Cameron a two-time tag champion and Statlander an AEW Triple Crown winner.

stories.title: The Cut Defeats Death Riders in Anarchy in the Arena Match at Full Gear
stories.tldr: At AEW Full Gear 2026, The Cut secured a major victory over the combined forces of The Death Riders and The Conglomeration in a chaotic Anarchy in the Arena match. The brutal bout featured broken glass, a flaming table, and numerous surprise appearances including the Phoenix Suns mascot, Mercedes Mone, CMLL star Kemalito, and a returning Claudio Castagnoli. The finish saw Jay White connect with a Blade Runner on Jon Moxley over shattered glass to score the decisive pinfall.

stories.title: Kazuchika Okada Defeats Adam Copeland to Retain AEW International Championship at Full Gear
stories.tldr: Kazuchika Okada successfully defended his AEW International Championship against pro wrestling veteran Adam Copeland in a brutal opening match at AEW Full Gear. The nearly 19-minute encounter featured fierce action, including both icons mocking each other's signature moves and taunts. Okada ultimately secured the victory by hitting an Impaler DDT on the exposed ringside floor followed by a devastating Rainmaker. For good measure, the champion delivered one final Rainmaker to Copeland after the match concluded.

stories.title: Tony Khan to Announce AEW Continental Classic Entrants During Monday Night Football
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan has announced that the 2026 Continental Classic tournament will kick off on the November 18 episode of AEW Dynamite in Denver, Colorado. To reveal the 12 competitors divided into the Blue and Gold leagues, Khan and Tony Schiavone will co-host a special selection show airing on AEW social media channels during halftime of Monday Night Football on November 16. Khan noted that the final participants will depend on evaluating wrestler health following the Full Gear pay-per-view, with the tournament culminating in the semi-finals and finals at AEW Worlds End on December 19.

stories.title: Tony Khan Confirms Persephone Signed to Multi-Year AEW Deal
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan announced during the Full Gear post-show press conference that CMLL standout Persephone is signed to a multi-year agreement, securing her future with both promotions well beyond 2026. The reigning CMLL World Women’s Championship holder previously signed a dual contract in January 2026, leading to earlier speculation about her contract expiration and unfounded rumors regarding WWE interest. Currently aligned with Britt Baker and a former TBS Champion, Persephone competed in a four-way match for the TBS title at Full Gear before Khan officially clarified her long-term status.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear Post-Show Media Scrum
stories.tldr: Following the AEW Full Gear pay-per-view in Phoenix, Arizona, company president Tony Khan and top wrestling stars gathered for the post-show media scrum. The event closed with Will Ospreay successfully defending the AEW world championship against Kyle Fletcher, followed by a shocking appearance by MJF. The packed 12-match card also featured title changes, major returns, and shocking debuts that provided plenty of talking points for the post-show press conference.

stories.title: Samoa Joe vs. Jack Perry Set for AEW Dynamite Following Pre-Show Brawl
stories.tldr: Jack Perry provoked Samoa Joe during the AEW Full Gear Tailgate Brawl by defeating The Beast Mortos, using Joe's signature Muscle Buster, and calling him out on camera after travel issues prevented Joe from attending the pay-per-view. In response, Joe delivered a chilling video warning rejecting Perry's desire for a handshake and promising to strangle him unconscious. AEW has now officially booked a singles match between Samoa Joe and Jack Perry for the post-Full Gear episode of AEW Dynamite. Additionally, the upcoming episode will feature the start of the 2026 Continental Classic tournament, with participants being revealed on November 16th.

stories.title: AEW Unveils Redesigned World Trios Belts Featuring Tribute to PAC
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has unveiled a redesigned look for its World Trios Championship belts that includes a heartfelt tribute to the late Benjamin Satterley, also known as PAC. The updated titles feature gold plates, black leather straps, an engraved side plate, and a memorial inscription on the back reading In Memory of Benjamin Satterley 1986-2026. As a two-time champion who helped establish the division through his work with Death Triangle and the Death Riders, PAC's legacy will now remain permanently tied to the championships.

stories.title: Fan Accidentally Kicked in Face by MJF at AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: MJF made a shocking return at AEW Full Gear by attacking Will Ospreay after his match against Kyle Fletcher. While making his hasty exit by jumping over the ringside barricade, MJF accidentally kicked a female fan directly in the face. Fortunately, sources within AEW reported that the fan was completely fine and even laughed the situation off. This allowed everyone to shift their focus back to the storyline as MJF officially set his sights on the AEW World Championship.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear 2026 Review and Analysis
stories.tldr: AEW Full Gear 2026 delivered an action-packed event featuring a Texas Death match, MJF's return to attack the world champion, and Anarchy in the Arena. In a detailed review of the card, the women's tag team championship match was heavily criticized for poor build, bad placement, and a rushed title change. Conversely, the Young Bucks earned high praise for their phenomenal tag team title match utilizing a classic David versus Goliath storytelling formula.

stories.title: MJF Announced to Appear on Post-Full Gear AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Following a dramatic return at the Full Gear pay-per-view, former AEW World Champion MJF is scheduled to appear on the upcoming episode of Dynamite. MJF shocked the wrestling world by launching a surprise attack on AEW World Champion Will Ospreay after Ospreay successfully defended his title against Kyle Fletcher. AEW President Tony Khan later confirmed during the post-show media scrum that MJF will address his shocking actions live on television. The heavily anticipated appearance highlights an action-packed lineup for the upcoming show, which also features the start of the Continental Classic tournament and a singles match between Samoa Joe and Jack Perry.

stories.title: Bandido Shows Off Head Wound After Texas Death Match
stories.tldr: Bandido suffered a nasty head wound requiring stitches after participating in a brutal Texas Death Match at AEW Full Gear. He shared a graphic photo on Twitter showcasing the deep cut he sustained during the chaotic championship bout. Bandido, alongside teammates Hangman Page and Brody King, ultimately lost their World Trios Championships to Swerve Strickland, Kofi Kingston, and Austin Creed. Despite losing the titles and enduring severe punishment from various weapons, Bandido provided undeniable photographic proof of the match's violent nature.

stories.title: Potential Second Entrant Declares Intentions for AEW Continental Classic
stories.tldr: Following his AEW National Championship loss to Ilja Dragunov at Full Gear, Tommaso Ciampa has officially declared his intent to enter the upcoming AEW Continental Classic tournament. Ciampa is looking to rebound from his short one-week title reign and prove his dominance against any opponent in the grueling competition. He joins reigning Continental Champion Jon Moxley as the tournament field takes shape ahead of Monday's official bracket reveal on YouTube. The 12 man tournament kicks off this Wednesday on Dynamite and will culminate next month with the semifinals and finals at the World's End pay per view.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Full Gear Fallout Preview
stories.tldr: AEW is presenting its Full Gear fallout edition of Dynamite this Wednesday live from Denver, Colorado. The card is highlighted by a freshly booked match between Jack Perry and Samoa Joe, which was put together after flight cancellations prevented Joe from appearing at the recent Tailgate Brawl pre-show. Additionally, the episode will feature the official kickoff of the Continental Classic tournament and an appearance by MJF to address his shocking attack on Will Ospreay at the conclusion of Full Gear.

stories.title: Backstage Update on Kairi's Status Ahead of Full Gear
stories.tldr: Former WWE and STARDOM star Kairi remains a free agent following her departure from the company in April. Although she recently appeared on Chris Jericho's wrestling cruise and met with Tony Khan, she has not yet signed a contract and currently lacks a US work visa. Meanwhile, fellow free agent Sheamus has not been spotted backstage at Full Gear despite widespread speculation linking him to AEW.

stories.title: Val Venis Demonstrates Outside Full Gear Venue in Phoenix
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Val Venis, whose real name is Sean Morley, staged a protest outside the venue hosting AEW Full Gear 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona. Holding a provocative anti-abortion sign, Morley live-streamed his demonstration and engaged with passing wrestling fans. While one fan gestured obscenely toward him, others stopped to take pictures and heard his controversial statistical argument linking abortion rates to wrestling demographics.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher Discusses Rapid Rise as Singles Star
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently admitted that his rapid ascent as a singles competitor happened much faster than he originally anticipated. After gaining prominence in New Japan Pro-Wrestling as part of Aussie Open, Fletcher transitioned into a successful singles run following his partner Mark Davis's injury in late 2023. Now a fixture in the singles division with reigns as both TNT and International Champion, Fletcher is preparing to challenge Will Ospreay for the AEW World Championship.

stories.title: AEW Arranges Private Charters Amid Flight Disruptions Ahead of Full Gear
stories.tldr: Following the nationwide FAA flight groundings, AEW President Tony Khan dispatched three private charter planes to hub locations to ensure stranded talent reached Phoenix for Full Gear. While these emergency flights successfully preserved the entire main pay-per-view card, minor adjustments were required for the Tailgate Brawl pre-show. Most notably, Maya World missed the event due to travel delays, prompting a last-minute change to the TBS Championship match.

stories.title: MJF Makes Surprise Return at Full Gear After Will Ospreay Defeats Kyle Fletcher
stories.tldr: MJF made a surprise return at AEW Full Gear by attacking World Champion Will Ospreay right after his successful title defense against Kyle Fletcher. The returning star laid out Ospreay with his Triple B belt and unmasked, officially kicking off his promised pursuit of the championship. He later posted a short message online reminding fans that he had warned them of his target.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov Defeats Tommaso Ciampa for AEW National Championship at Full Gear
stories.tldr: Ilja Dragunov defeated Tommaso Ciampa at Full Gear to capture the AEW National Championship, ending Ciampa's brief seven-day reign. The brutal, hard-hitting match featured heavy limb targeting, high-impact spots on the steel steps, and a dramatic finish sealed with consecutive D-Bombs. Following the loss, a frustrated Ciampa immediately shifted his focus toward entering the upcoming Continental Classic. Dragunov remains undefeated since his recent debut and is already being positioned as a fighting champion.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Retains Women's World Title Against Marina Shafir at Full Gear
stories.tldr: At Full Gear, Mercedes Mone successfully defended her AEW Women's World Championship against a fiercely dominant Marina Shafir. Shafir came agonizingly close to winning, even making the champion tap out outside the ring and later reversing a Brutalizer submission. Ultimately, Mone narrowly escaped with her title intact by stealing a tainted pinfall using the ropes for leverage. Following the controversial finish, the champion quickly fled the scene to celebrate her escape.

stories.title: Big Boom AJ Extends Undefeated Streak at AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: The Costco Guys arrived at Full Gear ready for action alongside QT Marshall to face members of the Don Callis Family. Big Boom AJ successfully extended his undefeated streak to 8-0 during the event. The viral star secured another pre-show victory after delivering his signature Powerboom in a chaotic multi-man tag team match.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear 2026 Betting Odds Update
stories.tldr: Major betting odds movements have hit the card for AEW Full Gear 2026. While Will Ospreay saw his massive lead narrow against Kyle Fletcher, Mercedes Moné and Queen Aminata saw their respective favorite statuses solidify. Meanwhile, the AEW World Trios Championship Texas Death Match has tightened up dramatically into nearly a pick-em scenario.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher Comments on Adam Copeland's Pending Retirement
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently shared his personal reflections on Adam Copeland approaching his eventual retirement. Fletcher recalled growing up as a fan of the veteran and witnessing both his past retirement and emotional return. Having already pinned Copeland in past competition, Fletcher now hopes for one final match to prove his superiority before the icon hangs up his boots for good.

stories.title: AEW Full Gear travel impacted as flight groundings leave wrestlers stranded
stories.tldr: A nationwide FAA ground stop caused by an air traffic control telecommunications outage left several AEW wrestlers stranded ahead of Full Gear 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona. While many talent members had already traveled directly from the previous week's tapings, the sudden shutdown sparked major concern over potential delays and card changes. Fortunately, the ground stop was eventually lifted, and reports indicate that everyone scheduled for the pay-per-view is now expected to make it to the event. The travel chaos also threatened other wrestling promotions like TNA and WWE, though those events largely avoided major disruptions.

stories.title: AEW's Bobby Lashley wins 4th Rope Heavyweight Championship
stories.tldr: AEW star Bobby Lashley captured the 4th Rope Heavyweight Championship at the Heelmatic event in New York by defeating Joe Alonzo in a quick two-minute squash match. The title change was orchestrated by 4th Rope General Manager MVP, who initially handed the vacant belt to Alonzo before forcing him to defend it immediately against Lashley. This victory marks Lashley's second active singles championship outside of AEW, as he also holds the ACW World Championship.

stories.title: AEW Collision viewership for November 11, 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Collision experienced a significant viewership increase for its November 11, 2026 episode, pulling in 500,000 viewers on TBS. This represents a substantial jump from the previous episode on November 7, which drew 376,000 viewers. The key P18 to 49 demographic also saw strong growth, rising to a 0.12 rating compared to 0.08 the week prior. Additionally, these numbers mark a massive year-over-year improvement of over 128 percent in total viewership compared to mid-November 2025.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite viewership for November 11, 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite on November 11, 2026, drew 742,000 viewers on TBS with a 0.16 rating in the key 18 to 49 demographic, marking a slight decline from the previous week. Despite the week-over-week drop in both total audience and demo rating, the numbers still represent an encouraging year-over-year increase compared to the same week in 2025. These figures exclusively track linear television viewership on TBS and exclude digital or streaming platforms as the promotion builds toward its next major live event.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone reflects on attending Forbes Power Women's Summit
stories.tldr: AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone recently attended the Forbes Power Women's Summit in New York City, bringing her title belt and a nose cast following her appearance at All In. Writing in her Mone Mag newsletter, she described the experience as incredible and a vital opportunity to represent the business and impact of women's professional wrestling among leaders from various industries. Alongside rubbing shoulders with notable figures like Serena Williams and Jennifer Garner, Mone discussed negotiation and her CEO persona with entrepreneur Haley Sacks. Looking ahead, Mone is set to defend her championship against Marina Shafir at AEW Full Gear on November 14 in Phoenix.

stories.title: Ricochet claims 97 percent of AEW locker room wants the best for the company
stories.tldr: Ricochet recently praised the All Elite Wrestling locker room for its strong sense of unity and shared ambition as the company celebrates its seventh year. Despite facing tragic losses and natural egos, he believes that the vast majority of the talent is entirely dedicated to making the promotion as successful as possible. He compares this positive environment to the camaraderie found on the independent circuit years ago. Furthermore, this resilient group is currently preparing to deliver a major show as the company approaches its upcoming Full Gear pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Stevie Richards criticizes crowd reaction to Darby Allin's Blood & Guts cage fall
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Stevie Richards recently discussed Darby Allin's dangerous fall from the top of the cage during a Blood and Guts event on his online show. Richards pointed out that the terrifying stunt failed to generate the massive crowd reaction or sustained concern that such a high-risk bump warrants, comparing it unfavorably to Mick Foley's historic Hell in a Cell fall. He noted that many fans remained seated instead of reacting with panic or awe, suggesting the spot suffered from diminished returns due to overexposure. Ultimately, Richards placed the blame not on the audience, but on creative repetition that has desensitized viewers to extreme cage spots.

stories.title: WON Flashback: Hangman Page vs. Kenny Omega at AEW Full Gear 2021
stories.tldr: On November 13 2021, Adam Page defeated Kenny Omega in the main event of AEW Full Gear to win the AEW World Championship in a critically acclaimed match rated five and a half stars by the Wrestling Observer Newsletter. The grueling 25 minute encounter featured heavy outside interference from Don Callis, brutal high risk maneuvers, and tense psychological drama involving The Young Bucks. Ultimately, Page overcame Omega's offense and used two Buckshot Lariats to secure the historic victory and capture the world title.

stories.title: Tony Khan praises Jon Moxley's support for Marina Shafir's growth
stories.tldr: Tony Khan is praising Marina Shafir's hard work ahead of her AEW Women's World Championship match against Mercedes Mone at Full Gear. During a recent media call, Khan highlighted how Jon Moxley has consistently gone to bat for Shafir as a mentor and advocate. Khan noted that both he and Moxley are immensely proud of Shafir's in-ring development and dedication to the company.
